tips.text: Check the Invasions tab once or twice a day and jump on any Strun Wraith part right away.
Run the invasion missions solo and sprint to the target; any fast frame clears all three in minutes.
Start watching early and let the parts arrive while you farm other things.
Go solo if the Grineer boarding pod fails to load in a squad.
Players call invasions tedious and rare rather than hard; most of the wait is the last missing part.
